Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure).

This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time.

SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket.

You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery).

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers — Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose — along with their documentation.

  • Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment.

  • Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized — not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases.

  • Take part in the team's shared medic rotation and resolve engineering-level support cases, feeding learnings back into development.

  • Contribute to the shared tooling (review, deployment, and test tooling) that SMX is building so other Camunda teams can adopt it — this is one of the team's current investment areas.

What success looks like (first ~3 months):

  • Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments.

  • Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements.

  • Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality.

  • Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement.

  • Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team.

  • Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product, with genuine curiosity about the customer problem behind a ticket — comfortable asking "should we build this" as well as "how do we build this."

  • Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).

  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams.

  • A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving.

  • You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker.

  • Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools.

  • Working knowledge of the Go programming language.

  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure/IaC (Terraform, Crossplane) — useful as SMX moves toward shared review capability across installation artifacts and reference architectures.

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Dans le cadre du projet “Horizon Europe EMPOWR” nous recrutons un post-doctorat en réalité augmentée. Sous la responsabilité de Guillaume MOREAU et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe INUIT, les principales tâches du poste sont :

 

  1. Définir un design space pour l’affichage d’informations pertinentes relatives à des tâches complexes

  2.  Construire l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif ainsi que les connecteurs avec les autres composants logiciels développés dans le projet

  3. Préparer le déploiement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif pour les deux cas d’usage industriels du projet

  4. Participer à des activités annexes du projet EMPOWR

 

  1. Définir un design space pour l’affichage d’informations pertinentes relatives à des tâches complexes

  • Collecte des tâches d’augmentation auprès des partenaires

  • Construction du design space des augmentations (où, quand, quoi, comment)

2. Construire l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif ainsi que les connecteurs avec les autres composants logiciels développés dans le projet

  • Développe un outil de réalité augmentée à l’aide de composants génériques

  • Implémente l’interface de mise en œuvre du design space

  • Définit les interfaces avec les autres composants logiciels du projet

3. Préparer le déploiement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif pour les deux cas d’usage industriels

  • Participe à la spécification détaillée des cas d’usage

  • Définit les exigences spécifiques pour le module de réalité augmentée

  • Participe à et superviser le développement de leur mise en œuvre

4. Participer à des activités annexes du projet EMPOWR

  • Participe à la rédaction des livrables

  • Participe aux assemblées générales du projet ainsi qu’aux réunions techniques

  • Rédige des publications scientifiques

Le Projet

L’objectif principal du projet EMPOWR est d’introduire un écosystème d’augmentation multicouches qui transformera les espaces de travail industriels en environnements adaptatifs et intelligents, où les travailleurs ne seront plus simplement des opérateurs, mais des décideurs améliorés. Cet écosystème favorisera la collaboration homme-machine grâce à deux technologies clés : un outil de réalité augmenté adaptatif, accompagné d’un compagnon IA cognitif, Adaptive Learning Manufacturing Assistant (ALMA ), un système d’IA basé sur des modèles de langage (LLM) qui jouera le rôle d’intelligence de l’espace de travail industriel.

L’équipe

L’équipe INUIT (Interaction Naturelle Immersive pour l’Utilisateur) du département Informatique mène des recherches sur l’interaction en réalité mixte en concevant des systèmes de réalité virtuelle et augmentée, en proposant des modèles et des métaphores évalués par des expériences utilisateurs. Les domaines d’application incluent notamment l’Industrie du Futur, la Santé, la Défense et le Patrimoine Culturel.

L’équipe INUIT est responsable de la conception et du développement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif. Ce dernier intégrera un espace de conception en réalité augmentée conçu pour prendre en charge plusieurs formes d’affichage d’informations via des augmentations. L’affichage s’appuiera en pratique sur des éléments fournis par ALMA ainsi que sur des signaux physiologiques surveillés chez les travailleurs. L’outil de RA sera déployé dans deux cas d’usage industriels, et des études utilisateurs seront menées pour validation.

  • Doctorat en informatique obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d’embauche

  • Visualisation de données (souhaitable)

  • Vision par ordinateur (souhaitable)

  • Informatique Graphique temps-réel

  • Gestion de projets

jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre. 

Cette thèse de doctorat sera rattachée au département Génie de l'Environnement pour les Organisations (GEO), membre du Laboratoire CNRS UMR 5600 Environnement Ville et Société (EVS). Pour répondre aux enjeux des transitions écologique, énergétique et industrielle, le département GEO accompagne les acteurs des territoires (acteurs publics et privés) vers une meilleure prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et de résilience territoriale. Il s'attache ainsi à apporter des solutions nouvelles en matière d'analyse, de modélisation et d'évaluation environnementale des systèmes industriels et territoriaux dans un double contexte d'industrie des futurs et de villes et territoires soutenables.

🏠 Contexte

Présentation du sujet

Le changement climatique met en lumière, comme l'a fait auparavant la crise COVID, les vulnérabilités et liens de dépendance généralisée de nos modes de vie envers les infrastructures, les chaînes de valeur, et modes d'organisation économique et technique, éléments souvent déconnectés de l'usager final, de ses besoins et des conditions d'occupation. Pour le secteur du bâtiment, Cimerman (2023) évoque une tendance depuis plusieurs décennies de « simplification cartésienne » de la conception et de l'opération du bâti. Celle-ci se traduit notamment par le développement d'un imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », se traduisant par une superposition d'éléments techniques complexes (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation), susceptibles d'être pilotés au travers d'outils informatiques et d'une gestion centralisée optimisée (Cimerman, 2023).

Face aux enjeux posés par le changement climatique, deux voies opposées d'adaptation du bâti se dessinent. La première, actuellement dominante, consiste à prolonger cet imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », rationalisable, mesurable et optimisable, et ce notamment au travers du développement du « smart-building ». Cette approche technosolutionniste apporte des réponses clés-en-main (capteurs, outils de pilotage centralisés, etc.) aux gestionnaires et usagers de bâtiments. Néanmoins, elle présente certains défis pour leur maintenance et leur entretien. Nous pouvons citer le recours massif aux nouvelles technologies, coûteuses, complexes, rapidement obsolètes et dont la fabrication repose en grande partie sur des ressources finies. Cela pose de plus les questions centrales des compétences, de la délégation du savoir et des outils associés à des opérateurs experts externes.

En contrepoint à la première voie, une seconde approche, encore marginale, émerge : celle d'un « bâtiment low-tech ». Popularisée ces dernières années en France par Philippe Bihouix (Bihouix, 2014), la low-tech questionne le rapport à la technologie et aux différentes formes de dépendances qu'elle génère (Tanguy et al., 2023). Dans le secteur du bâtiment, l'application de cette démarche renvoie souvent à la dépendance à la ressource (énergie et matière) : repenser les usages, l'origine des matériaux (réemployés, biosourcés) ou encore la simplicité de l'équipement utilisé. Bien que nécessaires, ces travaux s'intéressent pourtant peu à d'autres formes de dépendances associées à la technique, au titre desquelles nous pouvons citer la dépendance aux savoirs et aux formes d'organisation sociale et économique qui conditionnent l'adéquation, la pérennité et l'efficacité des solutions proposées.

Cette thèse offre ainsi une immersion concrète dans les questions d'adaptation du parc bâti au changement climatique par la « lowtech » à l'interface entre sciences de l'ingénieur et sciences humaines et sociales. Les compétences et l'expérience acquises trouveront une résonance particulière dans un secteur en pleine mutation, où la maîtrise des dépendances techniques, économiques et organisationnelles devient un enjeu central pour la soutenabilité des bâtiments et de leur exploitation.

Contexte scientifique

La littérature consacrée à la low-tech s'est structurée ces dernières années autour d'une critique de la fuite en avant technologique et des dépendances qu'elle engendre (Bihouix, 2014 ; Tanguy et al., 2023). Appliquée au bâtiment, cette littérature reste toutefois majoritairement centrée sur la phase de conception et sur la dépendance à la ressource : sobriété énergétique, choix de matériaux biosourcés ou réemployés, réduction du niveau d'équipement technique.

Deux angles morts en découlent. Le premier concerne la phase d'exploitation : la maintenance et l'entretien, qui représentent pourtant l'essentiel de la durée de vie d'un bâtiment et conditionnent la performance réelle des solutions installées, sont peu traités comme objet de recherche à part entière. Le second concerne la nature même des dépendances étudiées. Au-delà de la ressource, la conduite d'une opération de maintenance mobilise des savoirs et savoir-faire, des outils de diagnostic, des pièces détachées, des prestataires et des chaînes d'approvisionnement, ainsi que des cadres contractuels et réglementaires. Ces dépendances d’ordres cognitives, organisationnelles, économiques restent largement implicites et sous développées dans les travaux existants.

La caractérisation de ces dépendances soulève par ailleurs une question d'échelle. Analysée au seul niveau du bâtiment, la maintenance apparaît comme une somme d'opérations techniques ; replacée à l'échelle urbaine, elle révèle des réseaux d'acteurs, des filières, des compétences localement disponibles ou absentes, et des effets de dépendance mutualisés.

Contexte opérationnel

Du côté des acteurs institutionnels et économiques, de nombreux outils accompagnent aujourd'hui la gestion technique du patrimoine bâti. Nous pouvons citer :

  • les outils de gestion de maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO) et les plateformes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB) ;

  • les démarches de modélisation des données du bâtiment (BIM d'exploitation, jumeaux numériques) et les labels associés à la connectivité des bâtiments ;

  • les contrats d'exploitation et de maintenance externalisés, et les dispositifs de garantie de performance énergétique ;

  • les démarches et retours d'expérience issus de la mouvance low-tech (chantiers démonstrateurs, guides praticiens, réseaux associatifs).

Ces dispositifs partagent une orientation commune : ils visent à optimiser la conduite de la maintenance, rarement à interroger les dépendances qu'elle installe. Les démarches low-tech, à l'inverse, portent cette interrogation mais restent au stade de l'expérimentation ponctuelle, sans cadre d'évaluation partagé ni capacité de généralisation à l'échelle d'un parc ou d'un territoire.

Il en résulte, en l'état des connaissances aussi bien scientifiques qu'opérationnelles, qu'il n'existe pas de méthode permettant de rendre visibles et de qualifier les dépendances associées à la maintenance et à l'entretien des bâtiments, ni d'évaluer dans quelle mesure une approche low-tech permettrait de les réduire.


🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

Démarche de la thèse

L'objectif principal de cette thèse est de caractériser les apports d'une approche low-tech pour cartographier et maîtriser, sinon réduire, les différentes formes de dépendances associées à la maintenance et à l'entretien des bâtiments.

Les dépendances analysées s'appuieront sur les techniques, pratiques, outils et réseaux en lien avec la maintenance qui seront mis en évidence dans les deux autres thèses du projet PERENNIS. Cette thèse s'inscrit donc en complète continuité de ces deux travaux.

Dans un premier temps, il s'agira de construire un cadre d'analyse des dépendances liées à la maintenance du bâtiment, articulant quatre registres : les ressources (énergie, matière, pièces détachées), les savoirs et savoir-faire, les acteurs et leurs relations contractuelles, et les réseaux techniques et logistiques. Cette phase s'appuiera sur une revue de la littérature scientifique et « grise », sur un benchmark des pratiques et outils de maintenance existants, et sur des entretiens avec les acteurs du secteur (gestionnaires de patrimoine, bailleurs, mainteneurs, bureaux d'études, collectivités).

Dans un deuxième temps, ce cadre sera mobilisé pour caractériser et rendre visibles les schémas de dépendance à l'échelle urbaine, sur un ou plusieurs territoires d'étude. Il s'agira notamment d'identifier les sources de données mobilisables pour objectiver ces schémas, de qualifier les points de fragilité et d'apprécier leur variabilité selon les typologies de bâtiments et les configurations d'acteurs.

Dans un troisième temps, des stratégies prospectives low-tech de maintenance et d'entretien seront proposées et instruites. Il s'agira de construire des scénarios contrastés, d'évaluer leur capacité à réduire la vulnérabilité technique, économique et sociale des opérations de maintenance dans un contexte d'adaptation au changement climatique, et d'en discuter la faisabilité et l'acceptabilité avec les parties prenantes concernées.

Verrous scientifiques :

  • Définition et opérationnalisation de la notion de dépendance appliquée à la maintenance du bâti, au-delà de la seule dépendance à la ressource (savoirs, acteurs, organisations, réseaux)

  • Caractérisation et représentation de schémas de dépendance à l'échelle urbaine, à partir de données hétérogènes et partiellement indisponibles

  • Évaluation prospective de stratégies low-tech en l'absence de retours d'expérience consolidés et de métriques établies

  • Articulation interdisciplinaire entre sciences de l'ingénieur et sciences humaines et sociales, et capacité à répliquer l'approche tout en visant la « parcimonie » des méthodes et modèles

Objectifs de développement durable rattachés :

ODD 11 – Villes et communautés durables ·

ODD 12 – Consommation et production responsables

ODD 13 – Mesures relatives à la lutte contre les changements climatiques.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Formation : Bac +5 en ingénierie généraliste, sciences de l'environnement, génie civil ou énergétique du bâtiment, géographie/aménagement, ou discipline connexe. Une formation ou une sensibilité aux sciences humaines et sociales (sociologie des techniques, STS, économie de la fonctionnalité) serait un plus.

Compétences requises :

  • Méthodes qualitatives : conduite et analyse d'entretiens semi-directifs, observation de terrain, analyse de corpus documentaires.

  • Analyse systémique et prospective : capacité à représenter un système sociotechnique, à construire et instruire des scénarios.

  • Connaissance du bâtiment : compréhension du fonctionnement technique du bâti et de ses équipements, et des logiques d'exploitation et de maintenance.

  • Traitement de données : aisance avec des données hétérogènes issues de sources variées ; la maîtrise d'outils de traitement (R, Python) ou de SIG (QGIS) serait appréciée.

  • Gestion de projets : aptitude à structurer et mener des phases de projet de manière autonome, en articulation avec deux autres doctorants du projet.

Langue : français courant et anglais opérationnel (capacité à lire des publications techniques et scientifiques en anglais).

Profil recherché : individus responsables, proactifs, et dotés d'un esprit analytique, capables de faire preuve de rigueur scientifique. Personnes dynamiques, motivées par les enjeux environnementaux et par le questionnement critique de la technique. Capacité d'adaptation, goût pour le travail interdisciplinaire et collaboratif avec des acteurs variés.

jobs.description:
Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

Senior Analytics Engineer, Analytics & Insights 

London, UK (Hybrid, 2 days in office) 

Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials. 

About the role 

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Analytics & Insights, the team that owns Material Bank's analytics data layer, internal reporting, and data products that support our teams and brand partners. 

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who wants to own how analytics get built. You will take approved metric definitions and business questions and turn them into the models and metric logic in Snowflake and dbt, the dashboards, and the semantic layer and data products people use every day. 

You will own the analytics engineering for key areas of the business: understanding what needs to be measured, building the models, validating the logic, delivering the reporting, and keeping it accurate and reliable over time. You will work across multiple departments and across our data products, including embedded analytics for brands. The work varies day to day, and as a team we contribute to everything. 

What we require 

  • Ownership, end to end. You own what you build, from the first stakeholder conversation to the model, the dashboard, and the fix when something breaks. 
  • Precision and attention to detail. You understand the nuance behind a number, verify before you publish, and produce work that leaders and brand partners can trust without checking. 
  • Appetite for hard work. We are a small, ambitious team with a lot of goals. The work is demanding and the hours vary with what needs to get done. We are upfront about that because it is what the role is. 

What you'll do 

  • Own the analytics engineering for assigned business domains, translating metric definition through data model, dashboard, and insight. 
  • Design, build, and maintain documented, production-quality dbt models in Snowflake that turn approved metric definitions into reliable, reusable models and semantic definitions, and power reporting, self-serve, automation, and AI. 
  • Identify and resolve technical inconsistencies in metric logic so the business runs on one certified source of truth. 
  • Build a small set of high-value dashboards in Tableau (and Sigma, as we evolve the stack). 
  • Contribute to the semantic layer so certified metrics are reusable across BI tools, Snowflake Cortex, and embedded analytics. 
  • Automate recurring analytics work, with the tests and monitoring that keep it trustworthy. 
  • Partner with analysts and stakeholders to interpret data, build context, and surface risks before they are asked. 
  • Contribute to brand-facing data products used by account teams and manufacturer partners. 

What you'll bring 

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a similar technical analytics role, owning data models and reporting that a business relies on. 
  • Expert SQL on large and complex datasets. You write clean, efficient queries and can debug someone else's logic as easily as your own. 
  • Strong hands-on Snowflake and dbt (or a comparable modern data stack), including dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing, and documentation. 
  • Strong Tableau skills. Sigma, Looker, or similar a plus. 
  • Strong judgment on metric design: grain, denominators, filters, time zones, deduplication, and the ways a correct number can still mislead. 
  • Commercial sense and curiosity. You want to understand why a number matters, can explain what a change means for the business, and hold a position under questioning. 
  • An automation mindset. When you see something repetitive or fragile, your instinct is to find a better way to build it. 
  • Comfort working across several domains at once, prioritizing your own work, and managing stakeholders directly. 
  • Clear, concise communication and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 

Preferred 

Helpful, not required: 

  • Python for automation and data validation 
  • Marketplace, e-commerce, or B2B SaaS analytics 
  • Event and behavioral data (Segment, GA4, or similar) 
  • Semantic layers and AI-assisted analytics (Snowflake Cortex, dbt Semantic Layer, or similar) 
  • Embedded or customer-facing analytics (ClickHouse, Preset, or similar) 
  • Experimentation and causal methods: A/B testing, cohort analysis, difference-in-differences 
  • Catalog, product attribute, or search data 

What success looks like 

In your first 30 days you understand the stack, the models, the people, and the priorities in your domains, and you have your first dbt change merged. 

By 60 days you are producing real work independently: agreed metric definitions implemented, your first certified models and dashboards in use, and a plan for the first manual workflow you will automate. 

By 90 days stakeholders treat you as their analytics partner rather than a request queue. Your models are trusted, your dashboards are used without hand-holding, and your automation is reducing real manual effort. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership and hands-on responsibility. Direct people management is not required. 

What you'll get:

  • Our people: If you thrive in an inclusive, innovative, and fast-paced organization, look no further! You will get to work alongside some of the brightest minds - Join a genuinely fun and supportive workplace where we keep our employees consistently engaged through internal communication and corporate events
    Relaxation and Celebrations: Generous PTO, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect).
    Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical healthcare
    rowth: We'll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters!
    Flexible Work Schedules: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a hybrid working model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.
  • Application Process: Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter outlining their qualifications and relevant experience. We are committed to diversity and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. 

Material Bank connects design professionals to hundreds of manufacturers through facilitating brand discovery, sales rep engagement, and material sampling. Our powerful material database and proprietary robotic distribution facility allow members to order samples to be delivered free of charge overnight.Material Bank was founded by Adam Sandow in 2018 and has deeply transformed how the Architecture and Design industry works in the United States. It's an exciting time for the company - Material Bank is growing rapidly and expanding the business to Europe with regional headquarters based in Paris, and offices in London and Stuttgart. jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?"

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

The team brings together Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively.

As part of OAI4G’s International Public Sector team, you will help public institutions in the UK, Middle East (ME) and Latin America (LATAM) translate frontier AI into secure, compliant, mission-aligned outcomes. We work across varied procurement, regulatory, security, sovereignty, and commercial environments, while maintaining a consistent commitment to safety, reliability, and public benefit.

We are seeking a Global Account Director (GAD) to lead OpenAI’s public-sector work across the UK, ME and LATAM. You will build trusted relationships with government leaders, develop and execute account strategies, create and close complex opportunities, and help customers move from initial interest to successful adoption.

We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

The Commercial Field Engineer’s primary role is to serve as a technical advisor and champion for CodeRabbit customers in the Commercial tier throughout their post-sales journey. In this function, you will play a crucial role in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing success by partnering with Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Support teams to ensure customers realize the full value of CodeRabbit.

This is an exciting role for those who are technically curious and passionate about building AI-powered solutions for the SDLC. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact in an exciting, collaborative and fast-paced company that’s focused on making our customers successful.

  • Lead onboarding and implementation engagements for commercial and mid-market customers

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Technical Support Engineering, Technical Account Management, or Implementation Engineering

  • Experience onboarding or supporting SaaS, developer tooling, or infrastructure products

  • Strong technical knowledge of software development workflows and modern engineering tools

jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The Role:

We're looking for a dedicated, organised Senior Complaints Specialist to join us as we build our Complaints function in EMEA from the ground up - this is our first dedicated complaints hire in the region. You'll spend the majority of your time as a proactive, high-energy complaint handler: resolving complex disputes and keeping pace with our regulatory deadlines. This is much more than a standard complaint handler role: alongside resolving complex disputes, you'll lead our monthly complaints reviews, drive root cause analysis, and step up complaints handling processes for the region.

Who you are:

  • You're a natural complaint handler – you take ownership of a steady caseload, resolve issues objectively and fairly, and can turn a messy, technical problem into a clear explanation for the customer. You also have extensive knowledge of UK regulations including DISP and the FOS complaints handling process.

  • You're organised and deadline-driven – you manage your own schedule to make sure every case is resolved within the required legal timeframes, without needing to be chased

  • You're detailed-orientated– you can prepare thorough case files, gather evidence, and represent Airwallex professionally in front of the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • You're ready to step up – you’ll run our monthly complaints meetings and drive root cause analysis across EMEA.

  • You're a great collaborator – you'll work closely with internal teams to fix the root cause of issues.

  • You’re ambitious – you're excited by the idea of shaping how we run complaints across EMEA as our first hire in the function, and by helping us build how we use AI to handle complaints at scale

Responsibilities

  • Manage your caseload: Take ownership of a steady stream of complaints, meeting daily targets while maintaining high standards.

  • Meet regulatory timelines: Manage your own schedule to ensure every case is resolved within the required legal timeframes

  • Lead on regulator escalations: Manage cases that reach the Financial Ombudsman Service, preparing thorough case files, gathering evidence, and drafting Airwallex's final position

  • Own the regulator relationship: Act as the day-to-day point of contact with the Ombudsman, keeping our responses professional, timely and factual

  • Lead our EMEA complaints reviews: Run our monthly complaints meetings, bringing visibility to trends, volumes and priorities across the region

  • Drive root cause analysis: Work cross-functionally with internal teams to identify why issues occur, and lead the push for long-term fixes rather than one-off resolutions

  • Help build our complaints AI capability: As volumes grow, help shape how we use AI to handle complaints more efficiently at scale

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years' experience handling regulated complaints, ideally within financial services

  • Strong working knowledge of DISP and other relevant complaints-handling regulation

  • Experience preparing cases for, and liaising with, regulators such as the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • A track record of meeting productivity and quality targets in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English

  • Experience driving root cause analysis or process improvement cross-functionally

  • Confidence using AI-driven tools to automate manual processes and improve efficiency

  • Fintech or payments experience is required

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Berlin. At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us to let our consumers maximize value for their money by providing a world-class shopping rewards experience online and in-store, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap.
  • Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with 6+ years of experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side.
  • Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot.
  • Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems.
  • Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns.
  • Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and mentor more junior members of a software development team.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

And a little bit of....

Your experience

If you don’t quite tick all of these boxes but think you could still absolutely smash it, send us an application anyway and let us know why you’d be amazing in this role!

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English (we do service multiple languages, so any others you know are a bonus!).

  • Extensive customer service experience in a technical support role.

  • Prior experience in the Hospitality industry.

  • Ability to self-manage incoming emails, telephone calls, video calls, meetings, and on-site visits based on priority and customer commitments.

  • Strong computer skills and working knowledge of Mac OS.

  • Proven troubleshooting skills in a senior support position.

  • Strong problem-solving skills that will ensure our customers use their POS to its full capacity.

  • Ability to manage technical escalations of at-risk accounts and identify growth opportunities.

  • Flexibility in your schedule to work. Support never stops!

 

Even better if you have, but not necessary

  • Knowledge of networking or network support experience.

  • Understanding of API (relevant to SaaS) and experience supporting this.

  • Prior experience in a consultant role.

What’s in it for you

We're a global company, and our benefits vary depending on the country you live in. But here's a brief overview of our global benefits:

  • Equity options: We grant equity in the form of Restricted Share Units (RSUs) to our employees. Because this is your company, too.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

We are looking for a Mid-Level Security Engineer to own the hands-on engineering and operational work within our security program. You will be embedded in the Cloud Engineering team, report into the Security Officer, and work closely together to identify risks, set priorities, and drive security issues through remediation. You will act as a security enabler across all Product & Engineering.

What you will own

  • Run our public bug bounty program: triage reports, reproduce and validate findings, communicate clearly with security researchers, and drive remediation through to closure.

  • Investigate reported vulnerabilities at the code level, including our Rust core, Go and Python tooling.

  • Enable engineers to build secure systems: provide tooling, paved-road defaults, documentation, and practical guidance so security is the easy path, not a checkpoint.

  • Partner with engineering teams to design, review, and verify fixes, and set clear security requirements on changes where the risk warrants it.

  • Harden and maintain our GitHub organization’s security posture, including secret scanning, push protection, branch protection and rulesets, dependency alerts, and code scanning, in partnership with the engineering teams that use these repositories daily.

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and related infrastructure.

  • Track and report security metrics (vulnerability remediation SLAs, MTTR, patch latency, critical findings) and keep reporting current for the Security Officer.

  • Implement, configure, and maintain security tooling across our development and cloud environments.

  • Support security incident response, including investigation, containment, remediation, and follow-up.

  • Maintain clear, complete, and auditable records of vulnerability and incident work in our tracking systems.

  • Build security automation and guardrails that scale across the development lifecycle: CI/CD security checks, policy-as-code, GitHub automation, and automated cloud security controls, so secure defaults are enforced by tooling rather than review.

  • Participate in threat modeling and architecture reviews for new services and major changes.

We are also building out our ISMS, which creates opportunities to contribute to security-tooling evaluations, technical vendor assessments, and proof-of-concept work. Formal compliance ownership, vendor risk assessments, and customer security questionnaires remain with the Security Officer.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on security engineering, vulnerability management, and incident response. The Security Officer owns compliance, formal third-party risk assessments, and customer security questionnaires, allowing you to focus primarily on engineering work. On-call expectations are low: there is no formal rotation, though occasional availability for high-severity incidents is expected.

Who you are

  • You can read and navigate an unfamiliar codebase (Rust, Go, Python) well enough to validate a vulnerability report, trace its impact, and judge whether a proposed fix actually closes it.

  • You write and maintain automation and security tooling comfortably, and can hold a credible technical conversation in code review.

  • Experience triaging vulnerability reports or working with a bug bounty program, vulnerability disclosure program, product security team, or similar function.

  • Practical knowledge of cloud and container security, particularly AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with GitHub security features and securing CI/CD pipelines.

  • The ability to investigate alerts and vulnerabilities methodically, distinguish genuine risk from noise, and recommend proportionate remediation.

  • Clear written communication skills for working with external researchers and internal engineering teams.

  • A self-directed approach and comfort independently managing a security queue.

  • 3+ years in a hands-on security engineering, product security, or vulnerability management role.

Nice to have

  • An offensive security background, such as penetration testing, CTF participation, vulnerability research, or exploit analysis.

  • Experience working in an open-source company or contributing security improvements to open-source projects.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native incident response.

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.


Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!

About us

Gridcog is a global SaaS start-up of energy nerds on a mission to accelerate investment in the clean energy transition. We build project modelling software that captures the physical and commercial detail of energy projects, front-of-meter and behind the meter, so our users can make intelligent energy decisions. Our clients have modelled over 17k projects in over 40 markets globally.

Germany is one of our most important markets. We've built a strong brand here and work with some of the most active developers, IPPs and energy companies in the country, including MaxSolar, Lintas, Suncatcher, Octopus Energy Generation, TotalEnergies and Shell.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Energy Analyst with deep knowledge of the German power market to join our Berlin office. You'll be the second person in the office and a senior voice for Gridcog in Germany.

Your main job is to own our German customer relationships. You'll make sure customers model their projects well, get real value from Gridcog and keep choosing us. You'll use your market knowledge and network to make Gridcog a trusted voice in the market, help win new customers and make sure the product works for the target customer group. 

What you'll do

Customers (the core of the role)

  • Own a portfolio of German customer relationships as their main point of contact and trusted advisor
  • Lead onboarding and guide customers on best practice modelling of solar, BESS and hybrid projects in Germany
  • Handle complex technical and market questions, such as ancillary market participation, grid connection constraints, AgNes, and merchant versus contracted revenues
  • Spot where accounts can grow and work with account management on renewals and expansion
  • Keep our German datasets current, including market prices, network tariffs and project assumptions

Sales and marketing

  • Lead demos and technical conversations with prospects, including senior stakeholders, e.g., partners, investment managers, MDs
  • Build Gridcog's credibility in Germany and Central Europe through speaking at events and through your professional network, e.g., on LinkedIn
  • Translate regulatory changes and market design developments into clear insight for customers
  • Create blogs, videos and market commentary on the German market
  • Speak and present at industry events

Product

  • Bring German market requirements into product development and make sure they are understood and prioritised
  • Feed market changes into product direction and feature development
  • Test new features against real client use cases

What it's like being second in the office

Much of how we operate in Germany is still being built, and you'll often be the one setting it up. There won't always be a playbook. You'll need to make calls with incomplete information, act on them and adjust as you learn. We value moving fast over getting everything perfect, and we'd rather you ship something good and improve it than hold it back.

To be successful in this role you will have

  • 3 to 10 years' experience in the German power sector, with solid knowledge of market dynamics, regulation and commercial models for utility-scale solar and battery storage
  • A track record of owning client relationships and delivering excellent outcomes for them
  • The confidence and credibility to represent Gridcog externally, lead demos and engage senior stakeholders
  • Comfort working in an unstructured environment, making decisions and learning from what doesn't work
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data
  • An engaging communication style and the motivation to create content and present at events over time
  • A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working in a growing, international team
  • Fluent German and English, and based in or open to relocating to Berlin

We'd also love it if you have

  • Experience in sales or pre-sales, such as demos or client-facing analysis
  • Practical experience in energy project modelling
  • Familiarity with tools such as Excel, Tableau, Python or R
  • Exposure to other European energy markets

Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration package aligned with experience and skills
  • A Berlin office with flexible working arrangements
  • A high-performing team that values innovation and creative problem-solving
  • Exposure and influence over markets beyond Germany / Central Europe through our international footprint and global teams
  • Support for ongoing professional and personal development
  • An annual all-company retreat, with recent locations including Bali and Bintan Island

Diversity and inclusion

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team at Gridcog. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, as we believe an inclusive environment and diversity of perspective lead to innovation and success.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

The role

We are accelerating. The product works, clients renew, the market is taking shape. As our first Account Manager, you own the relationship with our brands from the moment they sign: you make their first campaign a success, you prove it with the numbers, and you grow each account from there. You report to the Head of Sales and write the customer playbooks with the Head of Sales and the CEO.

Account growth

  • Take over each brand at signature: onboarding, campaign setup, first results

  • Own the ongoing relationship: the next campaign is always planned, the next step always dated

Customer success & performance

Playbooks

  • With the Head of Sales and the CEO, write the account management playbooks (onboarding, reporting cadence, renewal motion), then run them

Market feedback

  • Feed what you hear from live accounts back to Sales and Product: what works, what doesn't, what brands ask for next

Must-have

  • 2-7 years in account management in the media, adtech, digital, marketplace or e-commerce ecosystem

  • You have personally owned a portfolio of brand accounts with a renewal or growth target. Running campaign logistics for someone else's accounts does not count.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Manager
jobs.description:
About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

The role

 

Gladia's growth is developer-led: most of our customers first meet us through our API, our docs, and other developers. As our Developer Relations Manager, you make sure that first contact turns into a successful build — and that what developers tell us makes it back into the product.

You'll be the public face of Gladia for developers building voice products — meeting assistants, voice agents, contact-center and sales-enablement platforms — with a strong focus on the US market. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and marketing, and you'll be measured on outcomes (adoption, activation, retention).

We want someone who understands what developers are trying to build, helps them get there faster, and builds lasting relationships with the community.

What you'll do

  • Own developer engagement end-to-end: understand developer needs, remove friction, and help them build successfully with Gladia

  • Create high-impact technical content — tutorials, demos, sample apps, blog posts, videos, talks, and docs contributions — that solves real problems and drives adoption

  • Represent Gladia at conferences, meetups, hackathons, customer events, and in online communities

  • Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and community leaders across the voice AI ecosystem

  • Be the voice of the community internally: turn developer feedback into clear, actionable input for product, engineering, and marketing

  • Design and run scalable DevRel programs: events, ambassador programs, partnerships, and community channels

  • Define and track DevRel metrics — adoption, activation, retention, community health — and use them to decide where to invest

  • Continuously raise the bar on developer experience, from first API call to production

Who you are

  • 3+ years in developer relations or developer advocacy, ideally for an API or infrastructure product

  • Technical enough to build demos and sample apps yourself and to talk credibly with engineers

  • Excellent public speaker and writer, comfortable across formats (stage, video, written, live coding)

  • Experience building and engaging technical communities, online and in person

  • Good judgment, tact, and humor when handling complex or sensitive community situations

  • Autonomous and organized: you set your own priorities and manage several in parallel

  • Fluent English

Bonus points

  • Experience leading a DevRel or community program (not only contributing to one)

  • Prior hands-on software engineering experience

  • Familiarity with speech, audio, or AI/ML APIs

  • Experience with open source projects and culture

  • An existing network in developer communities and on social platforms

What We Offer

  • This role is ideally based in Paris where you can work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking budget.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.description:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Contrôle de Gestion, vous serez au cœur du pilotage de la performance et de la structuration de la donnée financière. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes opérationnelles et la finance : analyser, fiabiliser et automatiser l'information pour aider les équipes à décider vite et bien, sur la performance commerciale comme sur les dépenses d'exploitation.

Au-delà du contrôle de gestion classique, vous contribuerez directement à nos chantiers data : construction d'une base CA/Marge unifiée et automatisation des reportings récurrents. Un vrai terrain de jeu pour un profil qui aime croiser finance et outils.

Missions

1. Analyse de la performance commerciale et du forecast

  • Assurer l'analyse hebdomadaire des installations, du sell-out et des stocks distributeurs.
  • Mettre à jour ces données dans notre outil de planification Anaplan et alerter sur les principales variations.
  • Participer aux revues mensuelles de forecast avec les équipes commerciales pour analyser la cohérence et les écarts au budget.

2. Suivi de la performance opérationnelle et des OPEX

  • Aider l'équipe finance à déployer le suivi des dépenses d'exploitation (OPEX) par service.
  • Analyser et présenter les suivis OPEX aux responsables budgétaires, avec un vrai rôle d'alerte sur les dérives.

3. Automatisation et fiabilisation du reporting

  • Contribuer à la construction et à la fiabilisation de notre base de données CA/Marge (réconciliation multi-sources SAP et e-commerce).

  • Participer aux analyses liées aux nouveaux flux : migration Shopify, partenariats B2B et nouveaux projets d'intégration.

4. Gestion des outils et analyses ad-hoc

  • Assurer la collecte, la mise à jour et la fiabilité des données dans nos outils de pilotage.

Requirements

Benefits

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen

jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu aimes trouver du sens dans ton travail et travailler sur une solution qui pourrait aider des millions d'entrepreneur demain ? Tu t'épanouis dans un environnement sain, dont les bases sont la confiance et l'autonomie ?

Alors peut-être que Pennylane est fait pour toi !

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs et les cabinets d'expertise comptable à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Pourquoi ce rôle est il si important chez nous ?

Le pôle Grands Comptes de Pennylane a été créé en janvier 2022 pour accompagner les 150 plus grands cabinets comptables français dans leur transformation digitale. Depuis, il s'est imposé comme un levier stratégique de croissance : ce sont des milliers de collaborateurs et de clients finaux embarqués sur Pennylane via des déploiement initiaux ou des rachats de cabinets.

Le Chef de Projet est le pilier de cette relation. Il est le premier visage de Pennylane pour nos partenaires stratégiques, celui qui pose les fondations de la confiance et garantit l'excellence opérationnelle à chaque étape. Avec la croissance du nombre de cabinets à accompagner, nous renforçons notre équipe de 6 Chefs de Projet pour continuer à délivrer un niveau d'accompagnement de haut niveau, mais aussi pour contribuer l’évolution nos pratiques de méthodologies de gestion de projet.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En rejoignant l'équipe Key Account, tu prendras en charge un portefeuille de cabinets comptables Grands Comptes à chaque étape de leur relation avec Pennylane : de la réponse à l'appel d'offres jusqu'au déploiement complet de la solution.

Ton impact se mesure à plusieurs niveaux :

  • Pour les cabinets partenaires : tu es le garant d'une expérience de découverte et de déploiement fluide, professionnelle et rassurante, qui transforme des décisionnaires exigeants en ambassadeurs de Pennylane.

  • Pour Pennylane : tu contribues directement à l’acquisition et au déploiement de nos plus grands partenaires, des comptes à fort enjeu stratégique et commercial.

  • Pour l'équipe : tu contribues à faire évoluer nos process pour les rendre encore plus robustes.

MISSIONS

Pilotage de la phase pilote (3 à 6 mois)

  • Organiser et animer les phases de test sur un échantillon représentatif de collaborateurs et de clients finaux du cabinet.

  • Garantir une couverture exhaustive des fonctionnalités Pennylane, en t'appuyant sur les outils d'analyse et la méthodologie de l'équipe, tout en l'adaptant au contexte de chaque cabinet.

  • KPIs : Maîtrise niveau 1 du produit, de la méthodologie et des outils internes. Prise en charge accompagnée de 1-2 comptes à M+3

Orchestration du déploiement (6 à 9 mois)

  • Construire et piloter le planning de déploiement en co-construction avec les intervenants Pennylane et les équipes projet des cabinets.

  • Coordonner les équipes internes Pennylane mobilisées sur le compte : commercial, migration, interopérabilité, consultant fonctionnel, formateurs, produit.

  • KPIs : Autonomie complète sur la gestion d'un portefeuille de comptes à M+8.

Relation et conseil client

  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence des décisionnaires des cabinets (associés, directeurs transformation, directeurs de production comptable).

  • Comprendre leurs enjeux métier, anticiper leurs besoins et proposer des recommandations proactives pour maximiser l'adoption de la solution.

  • KPIs : maîtrise de l’écosystème comptable, concurrentiel et de la réforme de la facturation électronique à M+3. CSAT > 9/10 à M+6

Conduite du changement & suivi de l'adoption

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie d'embarquement adaptée à chaque cabinet depuis la phase pilote jusqu’au déploiement et proposer des plans d'action correctifs le cas échéant

  • Accompagner les collaborateurs comptables dans la prise en main de Pennylane en analyant les indicateurs d'adoption en phase de déploiement et identifier les risques en amont.

  • KPIs : taux d'adoption des collaborateurs des cabinets conforme aux objectifs fixés avec les cabinets en fin de pilote ou déploiement

Contribution à l'amélioration continue

  • Challenger les process et outils de gestion de projet existants, proposer des améliorations concrètes et les déployer en équipe.

  • KPIs : premier retour structuré sur les process et rapport d’étonnement pertinent à M+3

🎯 Ce que l'on recherche ?

Must have

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet complexe, transformation digitale ou conseil (cabinet ou ESN).

  • Expérience avérée de la gestion de projets multi-interlocuteurs à forte dimension stratégique.

  • Excellente capacité à construire et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des profils décisionnaires exigeants.

  • Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies de gestion de projet (planning, gestion des risques, reporting).

  • Sens aigu du conseil : tu sais amener tes interlocuteurs vers la bonne solution avec diplomatie et conviction.

Nice to have

  • Expérience dans le secteur de l'expertise comptable, de l'audit ou de la Fintech/SaaS B2B.

  • Bases comptables ou compréhension des enjeux de la transformation digitale en cabinet d’expertise comptable.

  • Expérience en conduite du changement.

Ce qui fera la différence

  • Un profil qui sait être à la fois rigoureux sur la méthode et agile dans l'exécution.

  • Une vraie envie de construire, d'améliorer et de laisser une empreinte sur les process de l'équipe.

  • Une posture naturellement orientée conseil et accompagnement, pas uniquement delivery.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Entretien Who avec Aurélie Djoki (Team Lead Project Manager Key Account) - 45min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec Arnaud BERNARD (Head of Key Account) et Aurélie - 1h

  • Entretien final avec Tristan LENOIR (Directeur Partner Success) - 45min

🎁 Ce qu'on peut t'offrir ?

💵 Package : Fixe + Variable

🏥 Une mutuelle très complète (Alan Blue)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏢 De supers bureaux en plein centre de Paris (Wework Liège)

🏝 10 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏃‍♀️Un accès à 8000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via Gymlib

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Et enfin, l'opportunité de rejoindre une équipe internationale et dynamique : Nous faisons de nombreux sports ensemble (Foot, footing, escalade... etc), nous adorons passer du temps autour d'un verre, et les deux séminaires d'entreprise annuels (Hossegor, Les deux Alpes, Avignon récemment...) sont des grands moments de cohésion.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes
